literal_meaning: লিখে কিছু দেওয়া (writing and giving something)
figurative_meaning_en: To write something in support of someone
similar_in_english: Put in a good word for
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার চাকরির জন্য আমি একটা সুপারিশপত্র লিখে দিয়েছি।
বন্ধুর পক্ষে আমি সেই প্রতিবেদনটি লিখে দিলাম।
example_sentences_in_english: I wrote a recommendation letter for his job application.
I wrote that report in support of my friend.
note: This idiom is often used in contexts involving official or persuasive writing in Bengali culture.
